data_fields.name: tame_max_level_gap
data_fields.donor_constant: target level must be <= tamer level (gap 0)

data_fields.name: tame_pet_level
data_fields.donor_constant: equal to owner level at tame

best_idea: A tame is one ordered server-side gate (target level, tameable type and flag, one free companion slot, call spell known for that slot, not charmed, not owned) with fixed slot caps (5 active, 200 stored) and no random roll.
decision_why: Keep the ordered gate and slot caps; replace the hunter class test with a data unlock flag and re-run the gate when the tame is applied, because Frankendom is class-free and server-verified.
acceptance: A server test asserts that taming a beast whose level is at or below the player's, with a free companion slot, succeeds; a sixth tame returns active-slots-full and the creature stays alive.
